title: uva-ursi glandulosa
intro: Uva-ursi glandulosa, commonly known as bearberry, is a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to northern hemisphere regions. This plant has been traditionally used to treat urinary tract issues, such as cystitis and kidney stones, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and preventing bacterial growth. The therapeutic actions of uva-ursi glandulosa include its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic, making it effective in treating urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include arbutin, hydroquinone, and ursolic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
